faq.description: Everything you need to know about our plans and billing

items.q: Can I try for free before subscribing?
items.r: Yes, most of our plans offer a 14 to 30-day free trial with no commitment. You can explore all features before deciding.
We offer 4 cycles: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual. The longer the cycle, the greater the discount. You can change your cycle at any time.
A quota pack allows you to add extra resources (students, storage, SMS) to your plan without changing your subscription. The price is calculated pro-rata for the remaining cycle.

items.q: How do discounts and promo codes work?
items.r: Discounts can be automatic (volume, loyalty) or applied via a promo code. They are stackable up to a maximum of 40% of the total amount.

items.q: Can I change my plan midway?
items.r: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. A pro-rata temporis calculation is automatically performed to adjust billing.

items.q: What happens if I exceed my quota?
items.r: You will receive a notification at 80% and 90% consumption. Beyond the limit, you can purchase an additional quota pack or upgrade your plan.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.r: You can cancel at any time from your admin area. No commitment or cancellation fees. Your data remains accessible during the paid period.
Absolutely. Your data is hosted on secure servers with end-to-end encryption. We perform daily backups and comply with data protection standards.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.r: We accept Mobile Money (MTN, Orange), bank transfers, and major credit cards. Payments are secure and PCI DSS compliant.

items.q: Do you offer special pricing for large groups?
items.r: Yes, from 3 schools onwards, group discounts are available. Contact our sales team for a personalized quote.
